summary: A vision/resource-only repack cannot make this exact V2 artifact compatible with pinned ninfer-v100 b37d0dd3 while preserving every original text/MTP/DFlash object and template semantics. Two independent incompatibilities remain after adding the missing vision tensors and processor resources: ten unsupported DFlash2 tensor objects, and an unadmitted embedded chat template whose tokenizer_config lacks the required matching chat_template field.

artifact.evidence_scope: Complete cached directory plus exact pinned HTTP206 frontend-resource ranges. Full-artifact SHA admission was still pending when the resource receipt was captured; no incomplete weight payload was read.

complete_descriptor_analysis.missing_objects: 333 vision tensors plus frontend/preprocessor_config.json and frontend/video_preprocessor_config.json.

unsupported_original_objects.blocker: Pinned bind_dflash2 does not bind these objects. Binder::finish rejects every unconsumed object, including when speculation is disabled. Dropping their descriptors, hiding their payloads in an unreferenced trailer, or marking them arbitrarily consumed is not an allowed preservation/completion path.

frontend_blocker.semantic_difference_evidence: Diff against the admitted 8952-byte c3cf9e34 template is not only formatting: original V2 template adds developer/positional-system handling, final-assistant continuation, and tool-result histories without an original user turn. Replacing it with the admitted template changes declared template behavior. Exact existing-template admission fails independently of any possible overlap with native rendering behavior.
frontend_blocker.tokenizer_substitution_not_admitted: Original embedded tokenizer.json is 11071114 bytes; admitted W4A16 tokenizer.json is 19989325 bytes. No byte-equality claim is possible, and no alternate tokenizer was substituted.

vision_feasibility.processor_resources: Admitted preprocessor_config.json SHA27225450ac9c6529872ee1924fcb0962ff5634834f817040f444118116f4e516 and video_preprocessor_config.json SHA7768af27c1fafa9cc9011c1dc20067e03f8915e03b63504550e11d5066986d13 equal the real Qwen3.8 converter's official resource hashes.
vision_feasibility.conclusion: The genuine sidecar contains exactly the BF16 inputs required by build_vision_recipes(5120); these are not the blocker. Existing recipe/inventory describes the needed quantized vision objects without requiring BF16 base-text acquisition. This does not overcome DFlash/template incompatibility.

source_evidence.claim: Pinned Qwen3.8 NVFP4 text and DFlash2 binding contracts; DFlash2 uses 66 objects and no context_key/context_value descriptors.
Vision remains mandatory under ValidateOnly; present DFlash2 bundle is bound even when disabled.
finish rejects unconsumed objects and objects lacking materialization placement.
Only the two enumerated template SHA256 values are admitted.
tokenizer_config.chat_template must exist as a string equal to embedded template before template resolution.
Exact target persistent-object inventory used for complete cached descriptor comparison.
Genuine 333-tensor vision source names, shapes and patch-embedding reshape.
Real converter requires official frontend hashes; admitted processor-resource hashes match but original V2 template does not.
Source-backed encoded-size and allocation geometry used for directory-only analysis.

exact_missing_prerequisite: A genuine runtime/source contract that natively admits the exact original V2 template and all ten original DFlash2 context projections, with semantics preserved, is required; alternatively a publisher-supplied, fully hash-admitted artifact already compatible with the pinned target. Runtime/template-contract changes or substituting a different artifact are outside this assigned completion-only path. Finishing full-file SHA admission alone does not resolve these source-level blockers.
execution_limits: No converter implementation or stub, no source/build/model writes, no conversion, no GPU work, no package installation, no tests/builds/linters/formatters. Only bounded metadata/resource inspection, passive inventory comparison, native-source geometry analysis, and public-template diff were performed.
